{"description":"Planned (accepted intent 2026-10-12, nothing built yet). Three pages:
- **The home page (site/index.html), rewritten.** It covers the is / is-not of the partnership: the person decides, the AI drafts, asks and checks, the graph remembers. It covers the five decision steps in everyday words, and one design first, with the hub offered as the next step. It also says that reflow2 runs no AI, what it is not needed for, and which part carries over to a project that is not software.
- **A new page, the walkthrough.** A made-up example design is followed from its first requirement into the code and back (drift caught, a change's reach seen before the edit, results fed back). Each step is labelled with the person, the AI or the graph.
- **A new page, the why.** Each weakness of an AI (memory, confidence, agreeing) and of a person (confirmation bias, anchoring, slow drift) sits beside the check that answers it, drawn from docs/partnership.md. Fast and slow thinking is told as a likeness, and nothing claims reflow2 removes bias.

site/hub.html stays the guide to several designs, and "project brain" names only one of the two.
